close_reason: Already documented: email.rs:1208-1213 explains UTF-8 boundary truncation and why is_char_boundary walk-back is correct.
description: email.rs apply_body_value_args truncates body value strings using char_indices().take_while(|(i, _)| *i < limit) and sets isTruncated:true on the surviving entry. Truncating by byte index with &text[..limit] would produce invalid UTF-8 at multi-byte character boundaries. The char_indices approach is correct and must not be simplified to a raw byte slice. isTruncated:true is required by RFC 8621 §4.2 and must not be omitted.
title: maxBodyValueBytes truncation uses char_indices to stay on UTF-8 boundary
